interpretation: Natural expansion was highest pairMacroF1 among these four single-seed conditions; exact global50/50 was not tested.
More positive-pair presentations raised compatible recall but sacrificed incompatible recall.
POS2 publicLanguage gain coexists with pairMacroF1 loss; public scores did not override preregistered validation selection.
Original-question draw counts and unique coverage also vary at fixed token cost; this is not a pure prior-only intervention.
The auto-report phrase fixed pair budget refers to the fixed token budget; row counts were not held identical.

plan.fixed_input_condition: No extra truncation of unchanged cache; max2895; official test remains full supported input
plan.model: Qwen3-0.6B, causal BF16 SEQ_CLS LoRA r32/alpha64, ordinary trained score
plan.native_core_policy: Existing English SAR balanced-core law fixed in every arm; full core/tail draws logged separately
plan.task_mix: Identical generated per(pool,task) token ledger; reference0.5 sampler was used to define that ledger, not varied between arms
plan.independence: One continuation seed, shared R0 and reused natural dev; no independent full-flow or universal ratio claim

natural_dev_manifest.evaluation_population: All retained D0 validation rows in the unchanged train-task whitelist, plus all intact supported D2 dev questions
natural_dev_manifest.scope: Natural distribution within the declared Language-task and model-supported/intact population. Context exclusions are not full coverage; reused dev is not a new independent test.
natural_dev_manifest.test_policy: Official Language test unchanged, all candidates/full supported input; do not rebalance or threshold-tune.
